examples.arabic: جمعوا الحطب والمؤن، وتأكدوا إنو كل بيت جاهز للبرد القارس اللي ممكن يجي بأي لحظة.
examples.english: They gathered firewood and supplies, and made sure every house was ready for the biting cold that could arrive at any moment.
examples.transliteration: Jam'u el 7aTab w el mu'an, w ta'akkadu inno kell beit jahez lal barad el qares illi mumkin yeji b-ayyi la7za.

examples.arabic: أهلاً وسهلاً بالطعام الجاهز طعمه كان رائع جداً
examples.english: Welcome to the ready food, its taste was very wonderful.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan bel-ṭa'am el-jahez ta'mo kan ra'e' jiddan.

examples.arabic: هلا عم بستنى الاكل يصير جاهز
examples.english: Now I am waiting for the food to be ready.
examples.transliteration: Halla am bastanna il-akel yseer jahez
examples.storyTitle: Cooking a New Dish for the First Time

examples.arabic: الاكل صار جاهز بس شكله غريب شوي
examples.english: The food is ready but its shape is a bit strange.
examples.transliteration: El-akel sar jahez bas shaklo ghareeb shway.

examples.english: The kitchen is ready for food quickly.
